answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow: a new agent joins a trellis of timed tasks: a check, a harbor record, a receipt, while its first 40 POA sit in escrow. The trellis records how it works, so clones moving like one zephyr gust leave the same timing fingerprints and get flagged. Forging 1,000 distinct prints costs 1,000 x 40 POA locked plus weeks of work, far more than one epoch's share. An honest agent pays once and keeps every later reward undiluted.
